residual_findings.derivation: scan merely JSON-encodes status as a census key. The cell branch never validates a status vocabulary or even its type. An unknown text cell status does not trigger RECOVERED handling, has zero events, remains in all_cell_contexts, and can reach status complete. Likewise a word with any unfamiliar text status passes the text-only check and is skipped as non-RECOVERED. No vocabulary check distinguishes a legitimate negative status from an unknown one.
residual_findings.scope: The plan explicitly says unknownstatuses mustnotpassfullcoverage/custody. Retention is implemented but does not establish that rejection gate. No raw-prefix occurrence or executed counterexample is claimed.
residual_findings.next_action: Prospectively define authoritative permitted status vocabularies and optional-status rules, reject/classify unexpected statuses under an explicit incomplete/invalid gate, then publish/review a new source version; do not scan raw outcomes merely to select an accepted vocabulary.
